name: De Silveren Spiegel
description: Fijne Nederlandse keuken bij De Silveren Spiegel Restaurant de Silveren Spiegel in Amsterdam is een restaurant van uitzonderlijke kwaliteit, waar culinaire verfijning en historie samenkomen. Gevestigd in een prachtig 17e-eeuws pand, wordt dit gerenommeerde familierestaurant, eigendom van de familie Hoff, geroemd om zijn Fijne Nederlandse keuken onder leiding van chef-kok Yves van der Hoff. De lunch of diner wordt geserveerd in een van de vier intieme en sfeervolle kamers, elk met een eigen karakter en romantische uitstraling. Hier beleef je een unieke fine dining-ervaring, waar vakmanschap, gastvrijheid en smaak centraal staan. Ontdek de tijdloze elegantie en verfijnde gerechten van De Silveren Spiegel – een culinaire parel in het hart van Amsterdam.

name: Graham's Kitchen
description:
Welcome to Graham's Kitchen, the best authentic casual fine dining restaurant located in the heart of Amsterdam, Netherlands. Our team is committed to providing you with an unforgettable experience of delicious food and outstanding service. We use flavours and techniques from around the world to create a seasonal Chef's tasting menu of harmonious dishes with exciting combinations.

Our menu offers succulent seafood, mouthwatering meat selections, and vibrant vegetarian options to cater to every palate. We can accommodate most allergies and dietary restrictions, so please let us know when booking.

Along with our delicious dishes, we provide a warm, relaxed, and friendly atmosphere with attentive service, ensuring every guest feels like family. Whether it's a romantic dinner for two, a group celebration, or a private dining event, come and join us, and let Chef Graham and his team take you on a delightful journey of flavours and hospitality.

I hope to see you soon! Graham

name: Lepita
description: lePita serves the most delicious middel eastern cuisine. Authentic street food such as Falafel, Hummus & Shawarma, using the best ingredients in a traditional way of cooking. The restaurant is cozy & warm with a lot of character.

name: Restaurant Mont Blanc
description: Fine dining restaurant in Amsterdam. Gastronomic French cuisine situated in the city center de Pijp.
address: Govert Flinckstraat 308, 1073 CJ Amsterdam The Netherlands

name: Ali OcakbasI
description: Anatolia, a geography that has hosted many civilizations from ancient times to the present day, has a deep-rooted culinary culture. Ocakbaşı cuisine, which is an important part of Anatolian culture, is built on "sharing". Shaping this culture with a new approach , Ali Ocakbaşı invites its guests to enjoy the tastes of the Anatolian Cuisine and especially kebap, with a new generation ocakbaşı concept at iconic locations of the most important cities of the world. Ali Ocakbaşı continues to be the meeting point of those who love to "share", welcoming guests who want to spend every moment of the day in Istanbul, Amsterdam and Barcelona with its experienced team and a menu full of creative flavors.

name: Half Moon Cocktail Lounge
description: The Half Moon Lounge takes its name from the historic Dutch ship 'De Halve Maen,' bringing that same spirit of discovery to your evening. Overlooking the Noorder Amstel canal, our welcoming space offers the perfect retreat from the city, whether you're catching the sunset or warming up by our fireplace. Our skilled bartenders craft exceptional drinks while vintage vinyl sets the mood – each cocktail paired with its own carefully chosen song. Join us for an evening where classic hospitality meets Amsterdam charm.

name: Midtown Grill

photo.caption: A striking interior designed to match bold flavors.

description:
Welcome to Midtown Grill, the premier culinary destination for steak enthusiasts in the heart of Amsterdam. Our commitment to quality and the art of perfect grilling is evident in every dish we serve. At Midtown Grill, it's all about delivering an authentic steakhouse experience, where only the finest ingredients and the juiciest, most flavorful steaks are on offer.

Midtown Grill is renowned for its welcoming ambiance and expert service, making every visit a memorable experience. Whether you're here for an intimate dinner, a business meeting, or a special celebration, our team ensures that every aspect of your visit meets our high standards.

Our menu has been meticulously crafted to offer a range of tastes, from classic steak dishes to innovative culinary creations. Each dish is prepared with attention to detail and a deep appreciation for the ingredients.

name: Demetra - Italian Kitchen And Pizza
description: Modern Italian restaurant located in the heart of Amsterdam, specialized in homemade pizza, fresh pasta and contemporary Italian dishes.
address: Korte Reguliersdwarsstraat 8, 1017 BH Amsterdam The Netherlands

name: Restaurant Semai
description: Great variety of meals for Vegetarians & Vegans.

name: Namche
description: Our food concept represents the rich flavours and taste all the way from the Himalayas, unique dishes from the hills and spiced curries from the lowlands of Nepal and India. At Namche, we offer signature and spiced cocktails, mixed drinks and lassis. We also introduce our signature craft beer ‘Nepal Pale Ale’, brewed by Asperius Brewery Amsterdam
address: Lange Leidsedwarsstraat 91, 1017 NH Amsterdam The Netherlands

name: WE ARE EDN

photo.caption: WE ARE EDN, where you belong.

description:
WE ARE EDN is an all-day eating experience perfectly located in Amsterdam's heartbeat. It’s a welcoming space for hungry humans who value connection—both with each other and the environment.

Our vibrant team serves up breakfast and lunch classics, fun sharing plates, fresh salads, meat and plant-based burgers, pizzas, pastas, and grilled steaks—made with seasonal ingredients and rooted in the nature of things.

From the buzz of daily activations to the comfort of sharing great food in great company, WE ARE EDN is more than a meal—it’s a moment. After all, sharing is caring.

name: Kroegtijger
description: This property is temporary closed De Kroegtijger (roughly translated: café tiger/ frequenter of a café) is a traditional Dutch brown café turned modish hangout. Tucked away in the historic heart of Amsterdam, among the city's infamous red-lit windows and Chinese food joints, De Kroegtijger is a warm and welcoming bar with a small-town, unpretentious feel. It's the ideal destination for anyone out on their own, for sharing a drink with close friends, or for celebrating a special occasion. Showcasing unique aspects of local culture, De Kroegtijger serves all your usual favorites, as well as a superb selection of micro brews and indie offerings. Want a next level cocktail? Or an authentic Dutch 'kopstootje'? The owners'll get your drinks flowing, dim the lights and turn up the music!

name: Bar TWLV
description:
Named after our address on Stadhouderskade 12, Bar TWLV is inspired by the universal symbolism of the number 12: a reflection of balance, rhythm, and connection. From brunch to late-night drinks, this vibrant new space transitions effortlessly throughout the day, offering something for every moment.

Expect international sharing dishes, a zodiac-inspired cocktail menu, and an atmosphere that blends cosmopolitan flair with laid-back comfort. Whether you're visiting from afar or just around the corner — you're invited.
address: Stadhouderskade 12 Amsterdam Marriott Hotel, 1054 ES Amsterdam The Netherlands

name: Sherpa Restaurant
description: Since 1989, Sherpa Restaurant has had the honour of serving as the first Nepalese and Tibetan restaurant in the Netherlands, located in the heart of Amsterdam. Alongside our traditional Nepali and Tibetan dishes, we offer a curated selection of Indian specialities, celebrating the rich and diverse flavours of Nepal, Tibet, and India. At Sherpa, we see traditional cooking as a timeless craft—shaped by passion, patience, and years of dedication. Our Nepalese menu features gently spiced curries and fragrant rice, prepared with mild herbs and subtle seasonings. From Tibet, we serve comforting favourites like momos (dumplings) and hearty noodles, enhanced with authentic Himalayan herbs. Our Indian menu includes flavourful curries, tandoori dishes, aromatic biryanis, and freshly baked naan and roti—each dish made to order for a vibrant, satisfying experience. We warmly welcome your preferences or dietary needs. It’s always our pleasure to make your visit to Sherpa truly memorable.
address: Korte Leidsedwarsstraat 58-62, 1017 RD Amsterdam The Netherlands

name: Day's StoneGrill 1870
description: DAY'S StoneGrill 1870 is a steakhouse where you can go for lunch and dinner. The pieces of meat come from all over the world, such as Argentina, New Zealand and Canada. The menu specializes in grill dishes as in steaks, burgers and seafood. We also have a lot of vegan options. You can choose a side dish with every entree from DAY'S StoneGrill 1870, such as French fries, rice or vegetables. At DAY'S StoneGrill 1870's bar, all kinds of beer, wines and spirits such as vodka, rum and whiskeys are served. Here you have the option to grill as in 1870. We prepare all meat dishes perfectly from the kitchen and you can grill it at the table. If it's a nice, sunny day, you can enjoy your meal outside on the covered patio.

name: The Yeti - Nepali & Indian Restaurant
description: Located in the heart of Amsterdam at Spuistraat 54D, The Yeti Restaurant offers a delightful dining experience featuring authentic Nepali and Indian dishes. Our menu is crafted to deliver delicious and fresh flavors at a fair price. With a cozy and welcoming atmosphere, our professional and friendly service team, along with our experienced chef and cooks, are dedicated to providing you with an unforgettable dining experience. Whether you're a local or a visitor, we invite you to join us and savor the rich culinary traditions of Nepal and India.

name: Celia Amsterdam
description: Celia brings a touch of the sunshine state to the heart of Amsterdam. Located in the buzzing city center, the restaurant's bright and open spaces feel like an urban oasis with a nod to the optimism of the Californian way of life. Taking inspiration from California, with a mix of dishes to suit all, Celia's seasonal menus features market-driven, fresh ingredients prepared and served in a laid-back style. California offers some of the most diverse cuisine in the world reflecting a true melting pot of cultures in the state, so whether you're looking to indulge or stay wholesome, you'll find something you love.

name: Restaurant Bougainville
address: Dam 27 In Hotel TwentySeven, 1012 JS Amsterdam The Netherlands

name: Taste Like Chicken TLC

photo.caption: A sneak peek at some things you're going to eat at TLC 💜

description: To make the future of food fun, we decided to create the holy grail of fast-food restaurants. And so we proudly present TLC. The brand new plant-based chicken joint. Taste Like Chicken does exactly what it says on the box. We took the world’s best chicken dishes and flipped them into the future. 100% flavor, 0% chicken. Turning guilty pleasures into guilt-free adventures. Designed to make eating less meat as easy as a Sunday morning. And fun too. With a wide selection of styles, there’s always something for everyone. Dishes só good, you won’t believe it’s not chicken. But it is.
address: Van Woustraat 29h, 1074 AB Amsterdam The Netherlands

name: Gartine

photo.caption: Gartine serveert gerechten met groenten en fruit uit eigen moestuin. Voor een ontbijt, lunch en high-tea.

description: In the middle of the busy city centre (close to Spui) of Amsterdam you can enjoy a quiet and delicious breakfast, lunch or high tea at Gartine. We have place for a maximum of twenty-four people. Our products come directly from our own kitchen garden! We support the foundation ‘Adopteer een kip’ and work with organic eggs. On our menu you can find authentic regional products that meet the criteria from the Slow Food organisation.

name: Mondi Amsterdam New-west
description: Mondi Restaurant New-West Amsterdam is a unique culinary destination where the exotic flavors of the Caribbean meet a touch of French sophistication and the vibrant spirit of Amsterdam. Whether you’re looking to enjoy a relaxed lunch, a romantic dinner, or a lively night out with friends, Mondi is the perfect place to be. Our bar and lounge are open daily, offering a wide selection of signature cocktails and carefully curated wines that perfectly complement our dishes. With live entertainment and DJs setting the perfect vibe, your evening at Mondi is sure to be an unforgettable experience. Thanks to our convenient location and extended opening hours, Mondi Restaurant New-West is Amsterdam’s newest hotspot.
address: Aletta Jacobslaan 7, 1066 BP Amsterdam The Netherlands

name: Ku Kitchen & Bar
description: Ku Kitchen & Bar opened in 2014 and has been a buzzing bar and restaurant ever since. Located on one of the prettiest streets in Amsterdam, the Utrechtsestraat. We have weekly changing specials and classics. Sushi, wagyu burgers and lots of vegetarian options.

name: Bollywood Foodbar
description: Enjoy Your food @ Bollywood as a really Movie Star!! Cozy place with nice ambiance. Furthermore free Parking!
address: Johan Huizingalaan 118, 1065 JE Amsterdam The Netherlands

name: Truffle Boutique

photo.caption: The ravioli, filled with mushrooms & truffle. Served in a truffle cream sauce and topped with fresh shaved truffle and basil cress.

description: Like the name suggests we serve everything with truffle. Sandwiches, salads and our wagyu burger all with fresh shaved black truffle. On Wednesdays - Saturdays we are also open for dinner.

name: Milky Amsterdam
description: Creperie en cafe

name: Hearth
description: Plant-based Restaurant- Audio Bar. Contemporary plantbased restaurant presenting playful takes on worldwide traditions and serving them with humor, colours and creativity. In the old houses HEARTH was a fireplace made of stone used for heating and cooking. It was the vital center of the house and its most important feature. Our purpose is to create a warm and creative space where people can hangout and connect. We serve fusion plant-based dishes uniquely created in house by our chef. We host live jazz event and listening session with local and international talents. KITCHEN CLOSES AT 22 WEEKDAYS AND 22:30 WEEKEND

name: Utrechtsedwarstafel
description: AN EXPERIENCE. Within strolling distance from Theatre Carré there is the stage of Hans Verbeek and Esther van Meerten, the two culinary artists from restaurant Utrechtsedwarstafel. Their performance is a ballet of wine and food. Indulge yourself with the culinary compositions by Esther the Chef and the wines of Sommelier Winemaster Hans. This is the best restaurant dining experience in Amsterdam. An adventurous evening
